title: physostelma campanulatum
intro: Physostelma campanulatum, commonly known as 'Kantakari', is a plant species belonging to the family Asclepiadaceae, traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine. The health benefits of Physostelma campanulatum include its potential to reduce inflammation, promote digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to stress, and its ability to stimulate the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Physostelma campanulatum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
